sentences.en: Pressure acts perpendicular to the solid surface of an object.
sentences.zh: 压力垂直作用于物体的固体表面。

sentences.en: Dancing is a perpendicular expression of a horizontal desire.
sentences.zh: 跳舞是一种对水平欲望的垂直表达。

sentences.en: Lift is directed perpendicular to the flight direction.
sentences.zh: 升力的方向与飞行方向垂直。

senses.zh: 垂直的，正交的；直立的；陡峭的
